title: Track the temperature after release as well as at release
statement: The introduced four-bridge Lorenz-law model has L=2.44e-8 W.ohm/K^2, two 4e-5 J/K nodes, .2 W heating, 140 C melt point and 2 mJ latent heat. At R=.01 ohm, .1 A operation drops 1 mV/contact; release at .06201 s/12.402 mJ gives neighbor 130.782 C at release and 134.469 C later. At .1 ohm, the 10 mV/1 mW-per-contact trade gives .04057 s/8.114 mJ and 47.628 C at release but 75.503 C later, passing the introduced 80 C limit. Isolation is not always necessary in this model.
